summary.name: Koodo Reader
summary.one_liner: Koodo Reader is an open-source eBook reader that runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS and the web, with cloud sync of library and reading data.
use_cases: read ebooks across desktop and mobile devices
sync reading progress and highlights between devices
back up an ebook library to cloud storage
read EPUB, PDF, MOBI and comic files in one app
translate or look up words while reading
customize font and theme for night reading
summary.what_it_does: Koodo Reader reads over 15 ebook formats, including EPUB, TXT, PDF, MOBI, AZW3 and comic books. It syncs the library, reading progress, bookmarks, shelves, highlights and notes across devices. Sync and backup can use services such as OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, SMB and Docker object storage. Reading options include single-column, two-column and continuous scroll layouts, adjustable fonts, spacing, colors and margins, and a night mode. The page also mentions text-to-speech, instant translation, a built-in dictionary, AI-based translations and summaries, and batch import.
notable: Open source under AGPL-v3.0 with source on GitHub
Supports over 15 ebook formats including EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3 and comics
Syncs library, progress, highlights and notes via many cloud and network storage services
